markers.reading: The party approaches Darba in the late afternoon after the journey.

evidence.quote: DM: Okay, okay, so as you approach in the late afternoon, the sun creeping towards the vast expanse of the Nevos Sea to the west, you can see or imagine the layers of history that sit on the land here. So as you walk, you're traveling along the low rise of the land north of the river. So above where it sort of slopes down to a river valley, in the land here is lush and green and full of life. And while the ancient forests that once spread across Dunmar are gone, you can see echoes here in the trees of the river valley, of the riparian valley along the river floor, and the occasional stand of forest nestled among the gentle hills on both sides of the river. This is, you know, especially in the past few days, as you—as you've descended down from the foothills of the rocky mountains towards this coastal plain, this is the most trees you've seen in a long time. And while most of the forest here is managed for timber, which is obvious from the lumber barges that pass along the river and the water driven sawmills that are, you know, occasionally pass, and little small weirs and diversions along the ancient road, you can still feel a hint of this, of the land that used to be here. This, this is not—this, this land has been here for for a long time. This is not—you have to go further south to get to the new land that rose up out of the ocean when the plateau of the Dunmari desert and the Yuvanti Mountains.

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No exact civil date is independently spoken. The agreed August context is consistent with the YAML season, but its August 8–9 bounds cover only the Darba arrival and following day. Earlier played Sendings remain part of this extraction.
yamlCheck.explanation: The two played Sendings are about a week apart, and the later one is the night before arrival. Darba then has an explicit overnight and a following day. This exceeds a one-day session span under any supported opening boundary. The first journey activity and exact total boundaries remain open; drEnd has not supplied unrecorded elapsed time.
